tips.label: 不規則過去式
tips.text: 過去時間（yesterday、last...、...ago）出現時，一般動詞要用過去式；不規則變化要特別記憶。

tips.label: because 與 so
tips.text: because 引導原因；so 連接結果。句中有 because 時，不要再加 so。

tips.label: Why 問句
tips.text: Why + be 動詞 + 主詞...?；Why + did + 主詞 + 原形動詞...?

notes.title: 常見不規則動詞過去式
notes.rule: 原形 → 過去式，如 buy → bought、choose → chose、sell → sold、take → took
notes.description: 不規則動詞的過去式沒有固定規則，看到過去時間時要使用正確的過去式。did 或 didn't 後面則必須用原形。
examples: Dad sold his old computer last week.
Did you choose the red bag yesterday?

notes.title: because 表示原因
notes.rule: Because + 原因子句, 結果子句.／結果子句 + because + 原因子句.
notes.description: because 是連接詞，用來說明原因。because 放在句首時，兩個子句之間用逗號隔開。
examples: Because Harry could not cook, he ate out last night.
Harry ate out last night because he could not cook.

notes.title: so 表示結果
notes.rule: 原因子句, so + 結果子句.
notes.description: so 表示「所以」，連接原因與結果；前面通常加逗號。不要在同一句同時使用 because 和 so。
examples: It rained a lot, so I did not go out.
Ann broke her arm, so she went to the doctor.

notes.title: 詢問原因的 Why 問句
notes.rule: Why + was/were + 主詞...?／Why + did + 主詞 + 原形動詞...?
notes.description: be 動詞問句用 Why＋was/were＋主詞；一般動詞問過去的事時用 Why＋did＋主詞＋原形動詞。回答原因可用 Because 引導原因子句，或直接敘述原因；so 用來引出結果。
examples: Why was Ben late? — Because he missed the bus.
Why did you cry? — Because I was scared.

quiz.question: The children ___ new shoes at the market yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表過去；buy 的不規則過去式是 bought。

quiz.hint: yesterday 表過去；break 的不規則過去式是 broke。

quiz.question: I ___ a scary ending for my story last night.
quiz.hint: last night 表過去；write 的過去式是 wrote。

quiz.hint: yesterday 表過去；go 的過去式是 went。

quiz.hint: yesterday morning 表過去；leave 的過去式是 left。

quiz.hint: during yesterday's test 指過去時間，know 的過去式是 knew。

quiz.hint: last night 表過去；read 的過去式拼字仍是 read，不能加 ed，發音則是 /rɛd/。

quiz.question: My brother didn't ___ the chocolate yesterday.
quiz.hint: didn't 後面的動詞要回到原形 eat，不能用過去式 ate。

quiz.hint: didn't 已標示過去與否定，主要動詞使用原形 know。

quiz.hint: didn't 後接原形 buy，即使 buy 的過去式是不規則的 bought 也一樣。

quiz.hint: 過去式否定句是 didn't 加原形動詞，因此選 sell。

quiz.question: Did the baby ___ well last night?
quiz.hint: Did 開頭的過去式問句，主要動詞用原形 sleep。

quiz.hint: 問句已有 Did，choose 不再變成過去式 chose。

quiz.question: Did the ball ___ your arm during the game yesterday?
quiz.hint: Did 後面接原形 hit；hit 不可加 s、ed 或 ing。

quiz.hint: 助動詞 Did 後面的動詞用原形 take，不能用 took。

quiz.question: A: ___ was May absent yesterday? B: Because she was sick.
quiz.hint: Because she was sick 說明原因，因此問句用詢問原因的 Why。

quiz.question: A: ___ did you buy a new computer? B: Because the old one was broken.
quiz.hint: 回答在說明買電腦的原因，應使用 Why 引導問句。

quiz.question: Why ___ your brother scared last night?
quiz.hint: scared 在此是形容詞，問過去狀態用 be 動詞；your brother 是單數，選 was。

quiz.question: Why ___ the children late for yesterday's math test?
quiz.hint: late 是形容詞，問過去狀態用 be 動詞；the children 是複數，因此選 were。

quiz.question: Why ___ Tina sell her shoes last week?
quiz.hint: sell 是一般動詞原形，last week 表過去，問句須用助動詞 did。

quiz.question: Why did your little sister ___ after the movie yesterday?
quiz.hint: Why did 加主詞後，主要動詞要用原形 cry。

quiz.question: Why did Dad ___ the old computer to Uncle Ben yesterday?
quiz.hint: 問句已有 did，主要動詞要用原形 give，不能選 gave。

quiz.question: Why ___ you choose that pair of shoes yesterday?
quiz.hint: choose 是一般動詞，yesterday 表過去，疑問句要用 did。

quiz.question: Why ___ the ending of that movie so terrible?
quiz.hint: terrible 是形容詞，問句需要 be 動詞；主詞 the ending 是單數，四個選項中只有 was 合適。

quiz.question: Why didn't the children ___ action yesterday?
quiz.hint: 否定問句已有 didn't，後面的 take action 必須用原形 take。

quiz.question: The baby cried ___ she was hungry.
quiz.hint: 後半句 she was hungry 是完整原因子句，用 because；because of 後不能直接接完整子句，so 表結果，but 表轉折。

quiz.question: I bought this pair of shoes ___ my old shoes were too small.
quiz.hint: 舊鞋太小是買新鞋的原因，且後面是完整子句，因此用 because。

quiz.question: Ann went to the doctor ___ she broke her arm.
quiz.hint: 摔斷手臂是就醫的原因，用 because 連接；because of 後面不能直接放 she broke her arm。

quiz.question: We were curious about the story ___ nobody knew its ending.
quiz.hint: 沒人知道結局是好奇的原因，because 後面可接完整的原因子句。

quiz.question: Jack didn't go out ___ he had a math test the next day.
quiz.hint: 隔天有數學考試是沒出門的原因，使用 because 引導原因子句。

quiz.question: The computer was broken, ___ Dad bought a new one.
quiz.hint: 電腦壞了是原因，買新電腦是結果，因此結果子句前用 so。

quiz.question: The shoes were too small, ___ I gave them to my younger sister.
quiz.hint: 鞋太小是原因，送給妹妹是結果；so 用來引出結果。

quiz.question: The children were hungry, ___ Mom made a meal for them.
quiz.hint: 孩子餓了導致媽媽做飯，後半句是結果，使用 so。

quiz.question: The movie was scary, ___ the little girl covered her eyes.
quiz.hint: 電影很可怕是原因，遮住眼睛是結果，結果子句前用 so。

quiz.question: Tom lost his shoes, ___ he couldn't play basketball.
quiz.hint: 弄丟鞋子導致無法打球，後面是結果，因此使用 so。

quiz.question: ___ the baby was asleep, we spoke very quietly.
quiz.hint: 前半句 the baby was asleep 是完整原因子句，句首用 Because；Because of 後不可直接接完整子句。

quiz.question: ___ Sam broke his arm, he couldn't write during the test.
quiz.hint: 手臂摔斷是無法寫字的原因；Because 可引導完整原因子句，後面不用再加 so。

quiz.question: A: Why did you run away? B: ___ I was scared of the dog.
quiz.hint: Why 詢問原因，回答用 Because 加完整子句 I was scared of the dog。

quiz.question: A: Why were the children happy? B: ___ they got new computers.
quiz.hint: Why 問開心的原因；Because 後接完整子句 they got new computers，so 則用來引出結果。
